_comment: 联盟链接集中管理。改成你自己的推广链接即可。url 留空表示该项不显示。
_note: 所有链接必须是你自己的推广链接，填 affiliate id 后的完整 URL。直接用商家的主页链接不会有佣金。

payroll.name: Gusto
payroll.desc: Payroll, benefits and onboarding in one place. Adds employee self-service, which cuts the admin time most small employers underestimate.

payroll.name: ADP
payroll.desc: Handles multi-state filings, which matters once you have staff in more than one state. Steeper pricing but the compliance load drops sharply.

payroll.name: QuickBooks Payroll
payroll.desc: If you already run QuickBooks for bookkeeping, adding payroll keeps everything in one system instead of exporting and re-importing data.

cash.name: QuickBooks Online
cash.desc: Cash flow view, income and expense tracking, and built-in invoicing. Reasonable entry tier for a small business.

cash.name: Wave
cash.desc: Free invoicing and basic accounting with no monthly fee. Useful for testing whether you need more than basic cash tracking at all.

cash.name: Chase Business Complete
cash.desc: Built for small business banking. Automatic transaction feeds cut the time spent reconciling, which is where cash flow reporting usually stalls.

breakeven.name: Breeze
breakeven.desc: Accounting for very small businesses with no monthly fee, so you can track the actual cost side while testing a price.

breakeven.name: Square
breakeven.desc: Low transaction fees with no monthly charge, which matters most at the sales volumes a break-even test assumes.

breakeven.name: Stripe
breakeven.desc: Card processing with transparent rates, useful when break-even depends on keeping payment fees low as sales volume grows.

margin.name: QuickBooks Online
margin.desc: Tracks income and expenses by category, which is how you confirm the margin numbers this page estimates.

margin.name: LiveBookkeeping
margin.desc: Bookkeeping services for service businesses where the cost side is mostly contractor time rather than materials.

margin.name: Xero
margin.desc: Strong reporting and multi-entity support if your business structure is more involved than a single sole trader.
